_comment: Extra test/run.js flags per app id for tools/screenshot-registry.sh, so the per-app page picture shows the program rather than its About box, its setup dialog or an expired level timer. Batch numbers are where a scheduled --input lands; a dlg-cmd with no dialog open is a logged no-op, so the same command is repeated at a few points. Flags here are placed before the script's own, so a --max-seconds here wins.
